slides.title: Fences and carpets
slides.text: The yard's oldest argument starts every morning. The fence crew measures around a garden. The carpet crew measures inside it. Both crews are right, and they are never measuring the same thing.

slides.title: Around: add the sides
slides.text: Perimeter is the fence: walk the edge and add every side. This garden is 6 meters by 4 meters. Join its sides into one bar and the whole walk shows at once: 20 meters of fence.

visual.label: A bar joining the four sides of a 6 by 4 garden: 6 meters, 4 meters, 6 meters and 4 meters making 20 meters of perimeter

rows.label: Around the garden: add every side

focus.cue: Start along the long side: 6 meters.
The side opposite matches it: another 6 meters.
All four sides joined: 6 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 20 meters around.

slides.title: Worked example: carpet the garden
slides.text: Rough first: the garden holds about twenty squares, so an answer like 10 or 40 smells wrong. Cover it with unit squares: 3 rows of 7. Area counts the covering squares, not the edge.

visual.label: The garden tiled with unit squares: 3 rows of 7 is 21

focus.cue: Three rows of 7: 3 × 7 = 21 squares cover the garden.

slides.title: Same fence, new shape
slides.text: Two gardens can share one fence and hold different carpets. An 8 by 2 garden and a 5 by 5 garden both take 20 meters of fence. The long thin one holds 16 squares, the square one 25. Test it on grid paper.

visual.label: Two gardens, each with 20 meters of fence

focus.cue: Long and thin: 8 + 2 + 8 + 2 = 20 meters of fence, 16 squares inside.
Square: 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 = 20 meters too, but 25 squares inside.

slides.title: Stretch: the biggest carpet
slides.text: Stretch: with exactly 20 meters of fence, what rectangle holds the most carpet? Try 9 by 1, then 8 by 2, then 5 by 5. Which wins? Stretch work is never in the check.

slides.title: Words to know
slides.text: Four words the two crews shout across the yard.

words.means: the distance all the way around a shape
the amount of surface a shape covers
one square with sides of 1 unit, the counter for area
a rule written once that works for every case

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Brain Board at Practice Board and score 3,000 points to finish. It opens straight on your Around & Inside board, and your board saves as you go. Get there your way: lots of easy tiles, or fewer hard ones. Ask of every tile: is this the fence, or is this the carpet?
